app.name: KodeKantor

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: There is nothing to show here yet.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The request failed. Try again; if it keeps failing, include the request ID when reporting.

timeout.title: Timed out
timeout.body: The server did not answer in time.

disconnected.title: Disconnected
disconnected.body: No connection to the server. Check your network, then try again.

permission_denied.title: Access denied
permission_denied.body: Your account is not allowed to do this or see this data.

partial_success.title: Partly done
partial_success.body: Some steps succeeded; check the details before going on.

quota_exceeded.title: Quota used up
quota_exceeded.body: The usage limit for this period has been reached.

capability_disabled.title: Feature turned off
capability_disabled.body: This feature is turned off by an admin or a policy.

provider_degraded.title: Service degraded
provider_degraded.body: A service this needs is unavailable. Try again in a moment.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.body: Wait a moment before trying again.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.body: This does not exist or is outside your access.

errors.rateLimited_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.rateLimited_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.rateLimitedNoTime: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.

auth.brandTitle: KodeKantor — an AI team that builds your software
auth.brandBody: Every agent step is recorded as evidence; changes are applied only after you approve them.
auth.outcomeUnknown: The server's answer did not arrive, so the outcome is unknown: the password may have changed. Try signing in with the new password before retrying.

errors.emailInvalid: This is not a valid email.
errors.passwordMismatch: The confirmation does not match the new password.

login.title: Sign in to KodeKantor
login.subtitle: Use the account your workspace admin created for you.
login.invalid: Wrong email or password, or the account is temporarily locked.
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.
login.sessionNotStored: The server accepted the sign-in, but the browser did not keep the session. Check that cookies are allowed, and that the address uses HTTPS if your installation requires it.
login.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email to request a link for setting a new password.
forgot.sent: Request received. This version of KodeKantor does not send email yet, so no link will reach your inbox. Ask the operator of your installation to reset the password.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: At least 12 characters. Every old session is signed out once it changes.
reset.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
reset.noToken: Open the password reset link you received again. Each link works only once.

change.title: Change password
change.description: Sessions on other devices are signed out once the password changes.
change.wrongCurrent: The current password is wrong, or the account is temporarily locked.
change.conflict: The password just changed elsewhere. Sign in again.

menu.label: Account
menu.logoutFailed: Sign-out failed: the session is still active. Try again.

empty.title: No projects yet
empty.body: Create an empty project or start from a template that runs as is. Archived projects are under the Archived filter.
empty.filteredBody: Change the search words or the status filter.

new.title: New project
new.subtitle: Every project has its own git repository. Start empty or from a template.
new.name: Project name
new.blankHint: A git repository with a README and one first commit.
new.templateHint: A skeleton that runs as is, tests included.
new.templatesFailed: The templates could not be loaded.
new.outcomeUnknown: The server's answer did not arrive, so the outcome is unknown: the project may have been created. Check the project list before retrying.
new.noTemplates: No templates are available yet. Choose an empty project.
new.serverFieldSummary: The server refused the marked fields.
new.archiveHint: Upload a .zip, .tar or .tar.gz with your code.
new.archiveLimit: Up to 200 MiB, 1 GiB extracted, 50,000 files. A .git folder is not accepted: make the archive without history (git archive).

errors.nameInvalid: The name cannot contain control or invisible characters.
errors.fieldRejected: The server refused this value. Check it and try again.
errors.archiveTooLarge: The archive is larger than 200 MiB.

projects.archiveConflict: The project's status changed elsewhere. The list was reloaded.
projects.archiveOutcomeUnknown: The server's answer did not arrive, so the outcome is unknown. The list was reloaded to show the current status.

import.title: Import an archive
import.subtitle: The archive becomes this project's repository, with one initial commit.
import.notWaiting: This project is not waiting for an archive.
import.outcomeUnknown: The upload's answer was lost. The archive may have been accepted; try again to be sure (it will not be imported twice).

reason.format: Not a readable zip/tar archive, or damaged, encrypted, or using an unsupported compression.
reason.oversize: The archive or its contents exceed the size limit (200 MiB archive, 1 GiB extracted).
reason.ratio: The compression ratio is too high (looks like an archive bomb).
reason.too_many_files: The archive has more than 50,000 entries.
reason.link: The archive contains a symlink or hardlink.
reason.device: The archive contains a special file (device or FIFO).
reason.duplicate: The archive has the same path twice, or a file where a folder is.
reason.invalid_name: The archive contains a file name that is not allowed.
reason.traversal: The archive contains a path that leaves the project folder (..).
reason.absolute: The archive contains an absolute path.
reason.git_dir: The archive contains a .git folder. Make it without history, e.g. with git archive.

error.import_git_failed: A repository could not be made from this archive (git failed).
error.import_failed: The import failed because of a server error.
error.import_not_started: The archive was received, but the import could not start. Try again.
error.import_incomplete: The import stopped before it finished. Upload the archive again.
error.import_expired: The import waited too long and was dropped. Upload the archive again.

conflict.import_running: Another import of this project is running.
conflict.repository_not_empty: This project already has a repository.
conflict.not_an_upload_project: This project was not created from an archive.
conflict.project_archived: This project is archived. Restore it first.
conflict.import_expired: This upload ran out of time before it finished. Upload it again.
conflict.cleanup_failed: What an earlier import left behind could not be cleared. Contact the platform admin.

import.heldFile: Last file: {{name}} ({{size}}). Send the same file again, or choose another.
import.slow: The import is still running. You can leave this page; the project list shows its status.
import.runningHere: An archive import for this project is running.
import.stalled: The upload stopped before it finished. Try again.

dashboard.searchLabel: Filter the projects and tasks shown

queue.title: Needs attention
queue.filteredEmptyPartial: Nothing matches among the {{shown}} tasks shown; {{more}} more are not loaded.

agents.body: The platform does not record agent runs yet, so there is no activity to show.
